_comment: The related-issues.js edits of the Trump–Massie pass (Nov 2026): the privacy_rights / congress_oversight pair, its note, and the formal-act tally for an office that casts no roll calls. Each entry is the exact text before and after. Read by v103-chrome-seams.mjs#withoutDeclaredRelatedIssues so earlier passes' byte pins on related-issues.js set aside exactly these edits and nothing else.

edits.after:
· SURVEILLANCE PAIR (Nov 2026). Privacy & Big-Tech Accountability sits with
     Congressional Oversight: a Section 702 reauthorization (H.R. 7888, the
     Reforming Intelligence and Securing America Act) is mapped to both, so a
     FISA vote and a stated position on warrantless surveillance meet in one
     drawer. Existing keys on both sides, last in both lists, like the pairs
     above.

edits.before:
no for/against line gives its act count ("3 formal acts"). No votes
         on file reads "no record".
edits.after:
no for/against line gives its act count ("3 formal acts"). An office
         that casts no roll calls (the executive record) reads its formal acts
         the same way: the drawer's own tally of signed laws and orders on that
         issue ("0 for · 1 against"). No votes or acts on file reads "no record".

edits.before: var d = directionOf(pm, key), r = recordOf(pid, key, idx), v = hasVotes(idx);

edits.after: var tally = (!r && v) ? (acts || tallyText(pid, key) || indexTally(idx)) : '';

edits.before: hasVotes: function (pid, key) { return hasVotes(recordRead(pid, key)); },
edits.after: hasVotes: function (pid, key) { return hasVotes(recordRead(pid, key)) || !!execActsTally(pid, key); },
